journey.name: ED-04 Opening a task seeds the form and an edit reaches the list
journey.description:
Covers FR-05, and the navigation contract behind it: a route argument carries an id, not an object, so the editor refetches the task from the source through SavedStateHandle (TaskEditorViewModel.kt:49). A seeded form proves the refetch happened.
Edit mode makes one source call on open and one on save, so the dice are off.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that the title "Edit task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field contains "Renew domain registration"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field contains "Expires end of month"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is selected
Verify that "Due in 3 days" is on screen
Replace the contents of the "Title" field with "Renew the domain"
Verify that the app returns to the "Tasks" screen
Verify that "Renew the domain" is on screen
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is not on screen
Verify that the "Renew the domain" row has an element with the content description "Low"
Verify that "Renew the domain" is still the first row in the list
